lean.statement:
∀ {E : Type u_1}
  [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [inst_2 : CompleteSpace E] {f : E → ℝ} {X : ℝ → E}
  {z : E} {α T : ℝ},
  0 < α →
    0 ≤ T →
      Differentiable ℝ f →
        ContinuousOn X (Set.Icc 0 T) →
          (∀ t ∈ Set.Ico 0 T, HasDerivWithinAt X (-gradient f (X t)) (Set.Ici t) t) →
            IsMinOn f Set.univ z →
              (∀ (x : E), 2 * α * (f x - f z) ≤ ‖gradient f x‖ ^ 2) →
                (∀ t ∈ Set.Ico 0 T, HasDerivWithinAt (f ∘ X) (-‖gradient f (X t)‖ ^ 2) (Set.Ici t) t) ∧
                  ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc 0 T, 0 ≤ f (X t) - f z ∧ f (X t) - f z ≤ (f (X 0) - f z) * Real.exp (-2 * α * t)
approved_definition_context: Differentiable R f means Frechet differentiable at every point. gradient f x is the Riesz representing vector of its actual derivative on the specified complete real inner-product space. This predicate does not assert continuity of the derivative.

Set.Icc a b is the closed interval [a,b]; Set.Ico a b is [a,b); Set.Ici t is [t,infinity). HasDerivWithinAt X v (Set.Ici t) t means the right derivative of X at t is v. The curve has a total function type but derivative assumptions restrict only the specified interval.
ContinuousOn X (Set.Icc a b) includes both endpoint continuity relative to the interval. IsMinOn f Set.univ z means f(z)<=f(x) for every x. Function composition f composed X is t maps to f(X(t)).
